versions.content: Multiple asynchronous time bases Type: valid Description: The AUTOSAR templates shall provide the means to describe multiple asynchronous clocks/time bases and their interrelation. Rationale: In networked systems it is reasonable to describe synchronous events even for multiple asynchronous time bases. Use Case: Analysis and validation of timing behavior Dependencies: None identified. Supporting Material: None
